_metadata.purpose: USD per million tokens. bot.py prices every API call from this table (the per-turn and per-conversation budgets) and cost_report.py prices the logs from it.
_metadata.note: bot.py uses 5-minute cache writes (cache_control ephemeral, no ttl). Haiku 5.5: prompts up to 100 000 tokens; longer ones cost 5x as much.
